For menu filtering, parse the markup and search the resulting plain text with `Text.from_markup(value).plain`. The [markup docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst) describe this API. For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
